resources.string: Telegram’s familiar interface and animations stay standard. Extra styles are optional.
Preview a Material-inspired palette using the original Telegram theme engine. Apply only if you like it. Layout, fonts, bubble shapes and animations remain unchanged.
These open the existing Telegram settings. Choose animation and data settings to suit your device.

Google Maps and Firebase push are not configured. Maps are unavailable. Background notifications may be delayed or absent; delivery has not been verified. Phone-number and manual-code login use Telegram. Other upstream Google SDKs remain included.
Montogram is an independent client for the Telegram network. It is not an official Telegram app. Telegram Premium is a separate Telegram subscription.
Could not open the theme preview. Your previous theme is retained.
Maps are unavailable in this build because no map provider is configured.
An independent client for the Telegram network.\nFamiliar chats. Your choice of style.
Optional component styling. The Telegram layout is retained. The colour previews below are separate from this mode.
Could not save appearance. The previous mode is retained.
Adds a details action to the menu of ordinary messages. Off by default. Secret, protected, disappearing, spoiler and grouped messages are excluded.
A snapshot of the message metadata. Tap a row to copy its value.
Could not save the setting. The previous value is retained.
Transfers only Montogram interface preferences. Themes, accounts, chats and API keys are not included. Cancelled or failed exports may leave a partial document; a provider may finish writing later.
Could not transfer settings. Import accepts only a supported Montogram appearance file up to 4 KB. No settings were changed. An incomplete export file may remain.
Preview and reset only Montogram interface preferences. Themes, accounts, messages and Telegram settings are retained.
Settings changed after this preview was created. Open it again to review the current values.
These settings already match. Nothing was changed.
The document provider timed out. Backup transfers are unavailable until the app restarts. An export document may be partial or may change after the timeout. Your settings were not changed.
Another document operation is still running. Settings were not changed; a newly created export document may be empty.
Changes ordinary chat-list avatars and placeholders. Story rings, forum and community icons, Saved Messages and transition previews keep their standard shape.
Removes the stories strip from the chat list. Avatar story indicators and profile story viewing remain available. Changing this setting resets the top header position.
Shows known Telegram IDs in ordinary accessible profiles. Secret chats, topics and special profile views are excluded. Chat IDs use the internal MTProto format, which may differ from Bot API IDs.

Shows draft length and the standard single-message limit in the normal chat composer. Recording, editing, previews, bot controls and special modes use the standard panel. Telegram handles long messages normally. Emoji may use more than one position of the limit.
Adds seconds to absolute bubble timestamps using Telegram’s locale, time zone and 12/24-hour format. Relative seen and primary edited dates keep the standard format.
Paste an HTTP/HTTPS link (up to 4096 characters). Review the original and result before copying. Nothing is sent, opened or changed automatically.
Enter a valid HTTP/HTTPS link without spaces or login credentials, up to 4096 characters.
Known tracking parameters were removed. Review the result: signatures used by every website cannot be detected.
Possible signature, authorization or ambiguous query detected. The original link was retained.
No supported tracking parameters to remove. The original link was retained.
The clipboard could not be updated.
Confirm new personal voice/video calls and busy redials. Native replacement and voice-fallback confirmations remain; incoming and group calls keep their usual behavior.
For the panel, suggestions and greeting stickers in ordinary and scheduled chats. Cancelling keeps the draft. GIFs, Story replies and the sticker editor keep their usual behavior.
Adjusts bottom spacing in ordinary two-line rows in the main chat list. Search, folders, topics, forums, tags, three-line rows and enlarged fonts keep Telegram spacing.

Controls interface feedback, including mini apps. Less frequent allows at most one effect per 100 ms and respects the system haptics switch; effect strength is unchanged. Telegram default preserves native behavior. Incoming calls and notifications are unaffected.
Hide Share file in message menu

Reorders available translation, sharing, saving, statistics and message details. You can hide translation, external sharing and saving. Core actions and Telegram restrictions stay in effect. A menu containing only hidden actions keeps its original entries.

In ordinary and scheduled chats, releasing the microphone or pressing the recording send control opens Telegram preview. Use its Send button to confirm. Payment and scheduling follow that confirmation. Round videos, raise-to-ear and other recording contexts keep native behavior.

Prevents new text typing notifications, including in secret chats. Does not hide online or read status, voice recording, uploads or sticker activity. An already sent typing status may remain until it expires.

Up to 32 personal templates. By default they exist only while this app process runs and disappear after logout, force stop or Android reclaiming memory. Insert from the text selection menu; nothing is sent automatically.
Encrypted on this device, excluded from Android backup. Templates survive app restarts and logout; this Telegram account can access them again after login. Use Delete templates to remove them.

Save these templates encrypted on this device? They will survive logout and app restarts and become available to this account after login. They are not synced or backed up. Losing the device key makes them unreadable. Deletion does not promise secure erasure of storage.
Delete all quick reply templates for this account on this device, including any retained file and its key? This cannot be undone. Other accounts are unaffected.
Templates could not be loaded or saved. Reload to check the current state. Unreadable data is never overwritten automatically.
Use a nonempty name and reply text. Maximum: 32 templates, 64 characters in the name and 2048 in the reply.
No templates yet. Add them in Settings → Montogram → Chat tools → Quick replies.
Replace the current draft with this template? Nothing will be sent.
No bookmarks yet. Select an ordinary message and choose Add local bookmark. Only its reference and your optional label are stored, without a copy of the message.

Up to 128 local message references. By default they disappear after logout, force stop or Android reclaiming this app process. Open fetches the current message and rechecks access; protected or unavailable messages cannot be opened here.

References and your labels are encrypted on this device, excluded from Android backup. They survive restart and logout and are available to the same Telegram account after login. No message bodies are stored.

Save these message references and your labels encrypted on this device? They survive logout and app restarts. They are not synced or backed up; losing the device key makes them unreadable. Deletion does not promise secure erasure of storage.
Delete all local bookmarks for this account on this device, including their retained file and key? This cannot be undone. Quick replies and other accounts are unaffected.
Bookmarks could not be loaded or saved. Reload to check the current state. Unreadable data is never overwritten automatically.
Use at most 128 bookmarks and 64 characters per optional label.
This message is unavailable or protected, or its chat could not be verified. Nothing was copied. You can still delete the local reference.
Your whole-chat note (up to 4096 characters). An empty save deletes it.
No notes yet. Open a chat menu and choose Local chat notes. Notes apply to the whole chat, including all topics, and are never sent or synced. This list shows only chat IDs.
Up to 128 whole-chat notes. By default they exist only in this app process and disappear after logout, force stop or Android reclaiming memory. This manager never fetches chats or messages.

Your writing is encrypted on this device and excluded from Android backup. It survives restart and logout and is available to this account after login. Your notes remain editable here even if access to the original chat changes.

Save your notes encrypted on this device? They survive logout and app restarts. No sync or backup is created. Losing the device key makes them unreadable. Deletion does not promise secure erasure of storage.
Delete all local notes for this account on this device, including their retained file and key? This cannot be undone. Other accounts, bookmarks and quick replies are unaffected.
Notes could not be loaded or saved. Reload to check the current state. Unreadable data is never overwritten automatically.
Use at most 128 notes and up to 4096 characters per note. Invalid text was not saved.

Enter your own text (up to 8192 UTF-16 units). Montogram does not send or save this text; your keyboard and OS may process it. Input and previews are cleared when you leave or the dialog loses window focus, including overlays. Copying is explicit. Keyboard conversion covers US/Russian letter and punctuation rows; other characters stay unchanged.

UTF-16 units: %1$d
Unicode code points: %2$d
UTF-8 bytes: %3$d
Lines: %4$d
Letter/digit runs: %5$d

Runs join consecutive Unicode letters and digits, including following combining marks. This is not a linguistic word count. Lines split on CRLF, CR, LF, NEL, LS or PS; empty text has zero lines.

Known control, spacing, combining and bidi characters from a finite table. Positions are one-based Unicode code points. Some characters are legitimate parts of text and emoji. This is advisory, not a security verdict; nothing is removed.
No characters from this table found.
Text must fit within 8192 UTF-16 units and contain valid Unicode pairs, or the result could not be copied. Nothing was sent or saved.

Applies to the next eligible MD3 switch transition. Off settles this small control immediately; system-disabled animations always take priority. An animation already running may finish. Standard uses a 200 ms base curve; Android applies its own duration scale. Reduced motion, tabs, dialogs, navigation and other Telegram animations are not controlled by this setting yet.
бла бла бла созд монто грам

Structural heuristic for (), [], {}, «», “”, ‘’, „“ and straight ASCII quotes. Up to 8192 UTF-16 units. Brackets and quotes are checked separately. A quote closes the expected top glyph, otherwise it opens a known pair; apostrophes inside letter/digit/mark runs are ignored. This does not understand languages, escapes or code literals. Positions are one-based Unicode code points. Nothing is fixed, sent or saved.
No findings under this heuristic. This does not prove the text is correct.

Enter your own text, up to 8192 UTF-16 units. Preview removes repeated nonempty lines, keeping the first copy and its separator. Empty lines stay; spaces and case matter. CRLF, CR, LF, NEL, LS and PS delimit lines. Text is not sent or saved. Copying is explicit; leaving or losing dialog focus clears the preview.
Exact repeated lines removed: %1$d. Copy takes only the preview text, without this report. Kept rows retain their separators; a final separator may remain.
Plain text only. The Telegram limit is measured in UTF-16 units. Select a part to preview and copy it; nothing is sent. Joining parts preserves the original.
Shows one changed region between a common prefix and suffix, not a minimal edit script. Only manually entered text is inspected.

Common prefix: %1$d code points
Common suffix: %2$d code points

Removed:
%3$s

Inserted:
%4$s

HTTP(S) structure only, not a safety verdict. No network requests. User information, query values and fragments are hidden. The path and safe-form parameter names are shown and copied only on request; they may contain private information.
Advisory: finite Latin/Cyrillic/Greek ranges in letter and digit runs. Not a homoglyph detector or security verdict. Positions are Unicode code points.
Version, Android API and supported ABIs only; no account data, logs, tokens or paths.
Record counts and model-serialization bytes captured on refresh. Not RAM, disk or encrypted-file usage. No message contents are read.
Result not confirmed or data unavailable. Refresh before retrying.
The document provider is busy or timed out. No extra worker will be started.
%1$d own notes: note text and dialog identifiers will be given to the document provider you select. No account identifier or encrypted-store metadata is included.
%1$d bookmarks: dialog/message identifiers, your labels and folder names will be given to the document provider you select. No message bodies or account identifier is included.
%1$d templates: your labels and reply text will be given to the selected document provider. Source local IDs, account data and encrypted-store metadata are excluded.
Confirm the current snapshot after returning from the picker. A cancelled or failed provider may leave an empty or partial document. App records are not removed.
Templates: %1$d → %2$d. New: %3$d. Exact label/text duplicates are ignored; existing records are kept. Nothing is sent. Imported labels:

One folder per bookmark, up to32 NFC names of32 UTF-16 units. Move a bookmark to create a folder; empty folders disappear. Moving to an empty name removes the folder assignment. Older alpha versions cannot read stored folder data: unfile all bookmarks before downgrading.
Move %1$d bookmarks to Unfiled? Bookmarks, labels and references are preserved.
Delete %1$d selected local notes of the current account in one operation? Chats and messages are unchanged. Dialog identifiers:
